messages:
rachel: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2684
rachel: small style change and a rename in eng/runtime, switching cfg `ctxID` -> `context_id` for YAML/JSON keys plus running gofmt. low risk but want 1 approve before next deploy window.

sam: can you keep exported structs with CamelCase fields? i.e. Field ContextID string `json:"context_id"` so public API stays stable.

rachel: yes, kept struct field ContextID, added legacy loader in pkg/config/compat.go to accept both `ctxID` and `context_id` when reading. write-back always uses `context_id`.

tony: tiny nit on naming: prefer `TraceContext` vs generic `ContextID` in logs. not required for this patch.

rachel: noted, will track in follow-up issue (#1001) to avoid bloating this PR.

lint-bot: golint: exported type ContextID should have comment or be unexported — file eng/runtime/config.go:24

rachel: added a brief comment on ContextID and reran `gofmt -w` and `go vet` locally.

ci-bot: @rachel triggered rerun for CI (github actions) — retry flaky jobs

rachel: also updated a unit test name from TestConfigCtx -> TestConfigContextParsing per feedback.

sam: LGTM other than one tiny test var name suggestion, optional.

tony: approve from me :+1:
sam: approving now, merge after green.

rachel: merging after green and tagging for deploy window. target: merge before 09:30 PT tomorrow. @oncall-bot FYI
oncall-bot: noted — reminder set for 45m before window

rachel: thanks everyone!
